Z-Anatomy - The open source atlas of anatomy - CC-BY-SA 4.0

Adaptation: Cant Pin Me anatomical exercise model.
Muscle and skeletal subset, geometry decimation, grouped minor structures, neutral materials, and a simplified joint rig with manually defined skin weights. Original anatomical geometry retained. Exercise animation is illustrative; tissue deformation is not a biomechanical simulation.
